# BHK example sources

Design and custom footprints by runinit, copied from the workspace BHK
repository at commit `d8122c43930772fae1e80ba40fbd3d577e4e0ab6`.
Upstream: <https://github.com/runinit/blackholekeyboard>.

`src/examples/bhk.ts` preserves `config.yaml`, except its engine requirement
is updated from 4.1.0 to 5.0.0. The KiCad 8 template and geometry are unchanged.
The two required custom footprints are copied without modification and staged
alongside the existing pinned ceoloide library during the GUI build.
